body:
### Summary

`uv run` has various options to determine which package groups get installed.

However, in certain CI jobs I have no need for every other package to be installed (which can be a large amount of large packages), even within the same group. I just want the one the CI job is about to run, but I want to pull down the right version rather than the latest (which `uv tool run` does)

I have found a workaround in

```
uv run --only-group test --no-group test --with check-jsonschema check-jsonschema --version
```
(where group test is defined in pyproject.toml)

but that feels very hacky, and possibly even a bug that it's even possible

### Example

`uv run --only-package check-jsonschema check-jsonschema --version`
title: Add ability for `uv run` to only install a specific package
